answer: More aliases means more devices and more keys, each with its own willow proof, and each must still clear the cipher grading gate to earn. Each signing key is rate-limited to 1 submissions per epoch and tied to a device attestation, which means throughput per identity is fixed. The harbor counter resets at epoch open, which makes the throughput ceiling permanent rather than something a patient farming party can outlast. That is 13 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
